error.title: Could not load setup
error.body: DevDigest could not read your keys and repositories. Check that the API is running and try again.

storedLocally: Stored locally on your machine — never uploaded.

model.title: Connect a model provider
model.sub: DevDigest uses your own key for every model call. Nothing runs through our servers.

codeHost.title: Connect a code host
codeHost.sub: DevDigest reads pull requests and merge requests and posts review comments with your own token. Connect GitHub or a GitLab instance.

github.label: Personal access token
github.scopesNotReported: Fine-grained token — scopes are not reported by GitHub
github.missingRepo: This token has no repo scope, so DevDigest may not be able to read private repositories or post comments. You can continue anyway.

gitlab.baseUrlHint: Instance URL, including a relative URL root such as https://git.example.com/gitlab
gitlab.tokenSaved: Token saved — paste a new token to replace it
gitlab.scopesHint: Scopes: api and read_repository. A read_api + read_repository token can sync but cannot post.

repo.title: Add your first repository
repo.sub: Paste a GitHub repository URL. DevDigest clones it locally and imports open PRs.
